risks.title: Commodity price volatility (oil, gas)
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in risk factors (Item 1A), with direct language regarding financial results sensitivity. The company uses hedging but a 10 USD/bbl change can have a significant financial impact (up to 294 million USD reduction in payment).

risks.title: Counterparty credit risk
risks.score_rationale: Presented as a significant risk in Item 1A, affecting trade receivables and derivative instruments. The company monitors exposure but counterparty default may result in losses.

risks.title: Competition from renewable energy
risks.score_rationale: Identified in Item 1A, this risk is considered increasing due to technological advances and environmental policies. Competition is direct for electricity and indirect for hydrocarbons.

risks.title: Oil and gas reserves estimation
risks.score_rationale: Identified as a Critical Audit Matter in the audit report (Item 8), highlighting the complexity and subjectivity of judgments required. Reserve estimates directly impact depreciation expense.

risks.title: Post-acquisition integration (Berry Corporation)
risks.score_rationale: The acquisition of Berry Corporation is mentioned as a Critical Audit Matter (Item 8) regarding the fair value assessment of acquired assets. Integration and post-acquisition valuation present challenges.

risks.title: Interest rate risk (debt)
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 1A, but the company has no variable-rate debt, limiting immediate risk. The risk is therefore moderate for now.
